correctness.rationale: An E-block survives L_E L_F precisely when its F-expanded neighborhood is contained in S; similarly for the reverse order. Equal outputs are saturated by both partitions, hence by their join, and both outputs are subsets of S. On a partially included join-component equality therefore means both outputs are empty there, which proves the component criterion. On the connected alternating cycle the two neighborhood families together give all indexed four-point windows; at n=2 they all coincide as sets, and every proper input avoids them. For n≥3 a proper input containing exactly four consecutive points witnesses failure of universal commutation. The run-state automaton has a unique closed state sequence for each admissible indexed word, since a zero resets the state; the trace counts indexed words, not rotation classes. Adding the full set and normalizing by 2^(2n) is correct. The matrix is primitive with characteristic polynomial t^4-t^3-t^2-t-1 and its Perron root lies strictly between one and two, giving the claimed decay. Separate literal composition checks agreed on all 90346 partition-pair/subset cases through size five and all 87376 cyclic inputs for n=2 through 8; the replay reproduced the seven counts and the trace recurrence through length 44. The component and transfer arguments, not the finite replay, prove the unbounded results.
